Introduction

Gunmin is a South Korean singer, dancer, and choreographer, best known as a former member of the boy group B.I.G under GH Entertainment. He also participated in the sub-unit Gunmin X Heedo, the co-ed project group Triple7, and the Japan-Korea collaborative group NIK.

He made his official debut in 2014 as the main dancer and vocalist of B.I.G with the single “Hello”, which received attention for its lyrics promoting Korean culture. In 2016, the group signed with HY Entertainment and made their Japanese debut with the mini album “Aphrodite”, featuring a Japanese version of their song “Taola.” In 2020, Gunmin competed in the Japan-based idol survival show G-EGG, and was selected as a final member of the group NIK, which debuted in South Korea with the single “Santa Monica” in September 2021, followed by a Japanese debut with “Universe.” That same year, following J-Hoon’s military discharge, Gunmin was named the new leader of B.I.G and joined the seasonal co-ed project group Triple7. On January 14, 2023, GH Entertainment announced Gunmin’s upcoming military enlistment, which began on January 26, 2023. He was officially discharged on October 25, 2024.

After his military service, he briefly re-debuted in the group New And.B, which disbanded on March 23, 2025 following a final performance in Japan. As of 2025, Gunmin has not announced affiliation with a new agency. He is currently active as a dancer, choreographer, and instructor at Just Jerk Dance Academy and mu:tudio. Although there has been no official statement confirming his departure from GH Entertainment, he is presumed to have left the company following the dissolution of B.I.G and prolonged inactivity.
